'''Terna-Gentu''' lived on [[Temple Island]] on the [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]] and served as one of the [[Caretakers]], a group consisting of all of the [[Gender|female]] [[Lanai]]s on the island. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], she was washing [[clothing]] with another Lanai in the [[Jedi village]] when the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] emerged from one of the village's [[stone]] huts, having just accidentally fired [[Rey's blaster|her]] [[blaster]] through the building's wall.

==Biography==
[[File:Alcida-AukaFishScaling.png|thumb|left|250px|Terna-Gentu helped wash clothes in the Jedi village.]]
Terna-Gentu was a [[Lanai]] [[Gender|female]] who lived in the [[Caretaker village]] on [[Temple Island]] on the [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]]. The group were responsible for the upkeep of the ancient [[Jedi village]],<ref name="TLJVD" /> which was inhabited by the [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] traveled to Ahch-To to recruit Skywalker to the [[Resistance]] and receive training from him. After Skywalker reluctantly agreed to train Rey, the student began [[sleep]]ing in one of the [[stone]] huts of the [[Jedi]] village. After seeing a [[Force-bond|vision]] of her adversary [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], Rey accidentally blew a hole in the side of the hut and then emerged to find Terna-Gentu and the other Caretakers outside. While two of the other Lanais fussed over trying to repair the hut, Terna-Gentu and another Caretaker<ref name="TLJ" /> worked together to wash various items of [[clothing]] using a washstand, wash bucket and [[baleen-stripped washboard]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Personality and traits==
Terna-Gentu had [[Color|gray]] and white skin with blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Equipment==
Terna-Gentu wore a white [[Clothing|habit]] which she covered with a work apron that she washed [[Standard day|daily]] in [[Ocean|sea]] [[water]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terna-Gentu first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
